# NihilDigit

> Personal portfolio of Shibo Liu (NihilDigit), an undergraduate at North China University of Science and Technology working on edge AI, video systems, and open-source tooling.

Shibo Liu studies intelligence science at NCST. His main research line is ANVIL, a video frame interpolation method that reuses H.264 decoder motion vectors instead of learned optical flow so 30→60 fps interpolation can run in real time on mobile NPUs under 8-bit integer quantization. He is also third author on RAFNet, a relation-aware fusion network for dense classroom student behavior recognition.

Outside research he ships open-source tools and contributes upstream. Current highlights include waybar-ai-usage, a Waybar widget for Claude Code / Codex CLI / Copilot / OpenCode Zen quotas; coding-agents-setup, bootstrap scripts for local coding-agent environments; ongoing contributions to open-ani/animeko; and small upstream contributions to other open-source projects.

## Featured work

- [ANVIL project page](https://nihildigit.dev/anvil/): Accelerator-Native Video Interpolation via Codec Motion Vector Priors. First-author paper submitted to IEEE TCSVT, with an arXiv preprint and an Android demo player.
- [waybar-ai-usage](https://github.com/NihilDigit/waybar-ai-usage): Waybar widget showing remaining quota and reset time for Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode Zen. Uses browser cookies, no API keys. Packaged on AUR; mentioned in Awesome Codex CLI.
- [open-ani/animeko](https://github.com/open-ani/animeko): Ongoing upstream contribution work for Animeko, an open-source anime streaming app. Merged PikPak cloud offline-download work, active Windows on Arm64 support work, and danmaku timing refactor work.
- [Open-source community notes](https://nihildigit.dev/#featured-community-contributions): Smaller upstream contributions and bug reports, including a merged pikpakcli time-range download PR and a llama.cpp CJK tool-call argument issue.

## Papers

- [ANVIL: Accelerator-Native Video Interpolation via Codec Motion Vector Priors](https://nihildigit.dev/anvil/): First-author, submitted to IEEE TCSVT and under review. Reuses H.264/AVC motion vectors to prealign frames; achieves 12.8 ms 1080p NPU inference at INT8 and 28.4 ms median end-to-end latency on Snapdragon 8 Gen 3.
- [RAFNet: A Relation-Aware Adaptive Fusion Network for Dense Classroom Student Behavior Recognition](https://github.com/NihilDigit/RAFNet): Third-author, under review at The Visual Computer. Gated fusion of GroupRec hypergraph relation embeddings with ConvNeXt-Base appearance features. 63.08 Macro F1 on NCST Classroom; 96.76 cross-dataset on SCB3-U.

## Selected open source

- [renpak](https://github.com/NihilDigit/renpak): AVIF compression toolchain for Ren'Py visual novel archives. Shrinks image data by roughly 4–5× without forking the engine. Rust, MPL-2.0.
- [FocusWell](https://github.com/NihilDigit/focuswell): Android-first, ADHD-friendly time accounting app that turns daytime focus into a storable leisure reserve. Kotlin / TypeScript.
- [pikpak-kotlin](https://github.com/NihilDigit/pikpak-kotlin): Kotlin Multiplatform SDK for PikPak cloud storage. Handles session persistence, captcha auth, rate limiting, and resumable uploads. MIT.
- [coding-agents-setup](https://github.com/NihilDigit/coding-agents-setup): Modern local toolchain setup for coding agents, packaged as Windows and Linux setup scripts for tools, shell helpers, skills layout, and generated Codex/Claude rule files. PowerShell / Shell.

## Other projects

- [shulker](https://github.com/NihilDigit/shulker): TUI for a friend-group Minecraft server: whitelist, ops, world switching, config editing, backups, pre-generation, and tunnel control.
- [tokmato](https://github.com/NihilDigit/tokmato): Personal token-economy pomodoro app with multi-device sync, Web Push, and Android reminder relay. TypeScript / Kotlin, AGPL-3.0.
- [writing-style](https://github.com/NihilDigit/writing-style): Agent skill for prose style checks in Chinese and English.
- [csync](https://github.com/NihilDigit/csync): Chrome extension that syncs cookies and localStorage from normal windows to incognito for configured sites.
- [DeepSeek-Structured-Output-for-LangChain](https://github.com/NihilDigit/DeepSeek-Structured-Output-for-LangChain): Small compatibility patch for structured output with DeepSeek models through LangChain's ChatOpenAI interface.
